solidworks.description: Part modelling families: reference geometry, sketches, solid, surface, pattern and sheet metal features. Document, selection, state, configuration, properties, appearance, assembly, drawing, MBD, weldment, structure, cut list, mold, mesh, ScanTo3D, motion, routing, simulation, interchange, custom and strict data families are out of scope for this file.

fusion.description: Every Fusion feature type in the planner catalogue except abstract base classes.
fusion.excluded_reason: Abstract base classes with no createInput or add method; their concrete subclasses have their own recipes.

conventions: Use millimetres and degrees. World axes are right-handed XYZ.
XY is the SOLIDWORKS Front plane and the Fusion XY plane; XZ is Top; YZ is Right. Map planes by their basis, not their vendor label.
Start every case in a new document and save it with no other open documents.
volume_mm3 is the sum of the volumes of all solid bodies. Surface bodies count as bodies but add no volume.
Name every driving dimension after its parameter key so the edit can find it.
Follow the paired capture policy in PairSpecs.json for controls, rebuild, save, reopen and the edit-and-restore cycle.
A null volume means the result is not closed form. Record the measured value and the stated check instead.

build: On XY, draw a corner rectangle from (0, 0) to (40, 20) with driving dimensions seed_width_mm = 40 and seed_depth_mm = 20.
Extrude it 10 mm in +Z as a new body named SeedBody (seed_height_mm = 10).
On XY, draw a circle centred on the origin with driving diameter seed_diameter_mm = 20.
Extrude it 10 mm in +Z as a new body named SeedBody.
Build the block seed: (0, 0, 0) to (40, 20, 10), named BodyA.
On XY, draw a corner rectangle from (20, 0) to (60, 20) and extrude it 10 mm in +Z as a separate new body named BodyB. Do not merge.
On XY, draw a corner rectangle from (0, 0) to (40, 20).
Make a planar surface from it named SeedSurface (area 800 mm²).
Set sheet metal rules: thickness 1, inside bend radius 1, K-factor 0.5, rectangular relief.
On XY, draw a corner rectangle from (0, 0) to (40, 20) and make a base flange 1 mm thick in +Z named SeedSheet.
On XY, draw a corner rectangle from (0, 0) to (40, 20) and extrude it 5 mm in +Z (base plate).
On XY, draw a corner rectangle from (0, 15) to (40, 20) and extrude it from z = 5 to z = 25, merged (wall).
Build the block seed.
Convert SeedBody to a mesh body named SeedMesh with the coarsest refinement (12 triangles), keeping no B-rep copy.

recipes.name: Plane coincident with a face

expect.check: Record body count, volume, centre of mass and the feature tree. Z bounds -5 to 10.

recipes.name: Mid-plane extrude
build: On XY, draw a corner rectangle (0, 0)-(40, 20) and extrude it mid-plane with total depth_mm = 10.

recipes.name: Offset-start extrude
build: On XY, draw a corner rectangle (0, 0)-(40, 20).
Extrude 10 in +Z starting from an offset_mm = 5 from the sketch plane.

expect.check: Record body count, volume, centre of mass and the feature tree. Z bounds 5 to 15.

recipes.name: Extrude up to a plane
build: Create a plane at plane_z_mm = 30.
On the top face, draw a circle of diameter 10 at (20, 10) and extrude it up to the plane, merged.

expect.check: Record body count, volume, centre of mass and the feature tree.

recipes.name: Cut revolve
build: On XZ, draw a rectangle from (8, 0) to (10, 2) in (x, z).

expect.check: Record body count, volume, centre of mass and the feature tree.

build: On XZ, draw a line from (10, 0) to (10, 10) in (x, z).

expect.check: Record body count, volume, centre of mass and the feature tree.

recipes.name: Surface revolve
build: On XZ, draw a line from (10, 0) to (10, 10) and surface-revolve it 360 degrees about Z.

expect.check: Record surface area 200*pi mm².

recipes.name: Two-direction revolve
build: On XZ, draw a rectangle from (10, 0) to (20, 10).
Revolve about Z by angle1_deg = 90 one way and 45 the other.

expect.check: Record body count, volume, centre of mass and the feature tree.

recipes.name: Mid-plane revolve
build: On XZ, draw a rectangle from (10, 0) to (20, 10) and revolve it mid-plane about Z with total angle 90.

expect.check: Record body count, volume, centre of mass and the feature tree. Symmetric about XZ.

recipes.name: Boss sweep
build: On XY, draw a path line from (0, 0) to (30, 0).

expect.check: Record body count, volume, centre of mass and the feature tree.

recipes.name: Cut sweep
build: On the top face, draw a path line from (0, 10) to (40, 10).

Cut-sweep along the path.

expect.check: Record body count, volume, centre of mass and the feature tree.

recipes.name: Surface sweep
build: Path: line (0, 0, 0)-(30, 0, 0). Profile on YZ: line from (0, 0) to (10, 0) in (y, z).
Surface-sweep the profile along the path.

expect.check: Record surface area 300 mm².

Cut-sweep the tool body along the line (0, 10, 8)-(40, 10, 8), tool tip at z = 8.

recipes.name: Circular profile sweep
build: On XY, draw a path arc of radius 20 centred on the origin from 0 to 90 degrees.
Sweep a circular profile of diameter_mm = 4 along it (no profile sketch).

expect.check: Record body count, volume, centre of mass and the feature tree.

recipes.name: Thin sweep
build: Path: line (0, 0, 0)-(30, 0, 0). Profile on YZ: open line from (0, 0) to (10, 0) in (y, z).
Thin-sweep with thickness 1 to the +Z side.

expect.check: Record body count, volume, centre of mass and the feature tree.

recipes.name: Boss loft between squares

Loft between them with matching corners.

expect.check: Record body count, volume, centre of mass and the feature tree.

recipes.name: Cut loft
build: On the top face, draw a 10 × 10 square centred at (20, 10).
On a plane at z = 4, draw a 4 × 4 square centred at (20, 10).
Cut-loft between them.

expect.check: Record body count, volume, centre of mass and the feature tree.

recipes.name: Surface loft
build: Surface-loft between them.

expect.check: Record a planar strip of area 20*sqrt(200) mm².

recipes.name: Thin loft
build: Draw circles of diameter 20 centred on the Z axis at z = 0 and z = 10.
Thin-loft between them with wall 1 outward.

expect.check: Record body count, volume, centre of mass and the feature tree.

recipes.name: Centerline loft
build: Draw a circle of diameter 20 at z = 0 and of diameter 10 at z = 10, both on the Z axis, and a centerline along Z.
Loft with the centerline.

expect.check: Record body count, volume, centre of mass and the feature tree.

recipes.name: Loft to a point
build: On XY, draw a 20 × 20 square from (0, 0) to (20, 20) and add a sketch point at (10, 10, 10).
Loft from the square to the point.

expect.check: Record body count, volume, centre of mass and the feature tree.

recipes.name: Boundary boss
build: Use the two squares of the boss loft (20 × 20 at z = 0, 10 × 10 at z = 10).
Create a boundary boss in direction 1 only.

expect.check: Record body count, volume, centre of mass and the feature tree.

recipes.name: Boundary cut
build: Use the two squares of the cut loft.
Create a boundary cut between them.

expect.check: Record body count, volume, centre of mass and the feature tree.

recipes.name: Boundary surface
build: Draw four lines bounding the square (0, 0, 0)-(20, 20, 0).
Create a boundary surface from two opposite pairs.

expect.check: Record a planar surface of area 400 mm².

recipes.name: Simple blind hole
build: On the top face at (10, 10), add a simple hole of diameter_mm = 6, depth 5, flat bottom.

expect.check: Record body count, volume, centre of mass and the feature tree.

recipes.name: Counterbored hole
build: On the top face at (30, 10), add a counterbored through hole: hole diameter 5.5, counterbore diameter 10, depth 3.

expect.check: Record body count, volume, centre of mass and the feature tree.

recipes.name: Advanced hole
build: On the top face at (20, 10), add an advanced hole: near side counterbore diameter 10 depth 3, then a diameter 6 hole through.

expect.check: Record body count, volume, centre of mass and the feature tree.

recipes.name: Hole series through two parts
build: Make an assembly of two block seed parts, the second stacked on the first at z = 10.
Add a hole series of diameter 6 at (20, 10) through both parts.

expect.check: Record body count, volume, centre of mass and the feature tree. Each part file carries its own hole.

recipes.name: Modelled thread
build: Add a modelled external thread on the cylinder side face: pitch 2, full length 10, metric profile.

expect.check: Record body count, volume, centre of mass and the feature tree. Record pitch, length and handedness.

recipes.name: Cosmetic thread
build: Add a diameter 6 through hole at (20, 10), then a cosmetic thread M6 × 1 on it, full depth.

expect.check: Record body count, volume, centre of mass and the feature tree. The thread does not change the volume; record its attributes.

recipes.name: Stud wizard
build: On the top face at (20, 10), add a stud of diameter 6 and length 10 with an M6 thread.

expect.check: Record body count, volume, centre of mass and the feature tree. Record stud diameter, length and thread.

recipes.name: Constant-radius edge fillet
build: Fillet the vertical edge at (40, 20) with radius_mm = 2.

expect.check: Record body count, volume, centre of mass and the feature tree.

recipes.name: Variable-radius fillet
build: Fillet the vertical edge at (40, 20) with radius 1 at z = 0 and 3 at z = 10, straight transition.

expect.check: Record body count, volume, centre of mass and the feature tree. Record both end radii.

recipes.name: Face fillet
build: Face-fillet the top face and the side face y = 20 with radius 2.

expect.check: Record body count, volume, centre of mass and the feature tree.

recipes.name: Full round fillet
build: Full-round fillet with side faces z = 0 and z = 10 and centre face x = 40.

expect.check: Record body count, volume, centre of mass and the feature tree. The end becomes a half cylinder of radius 5.

recipes.name: Asymmetric fillet
build: Asymmetric-fillet the vertical edge at (40, 20) with distances 2 along X and 4 along Y, elliptic profile.

expect.check: Record body count, volume, centre of mass and the feature tree.

recipes.name: Partial edge fillet
build: Fillet the top edge along X at y = 20, z = 10 with radius 2, only from x = 10 to x = 30.

expect.check: Record body count, volume, centre of mass and the feature tree. Record the partial start and end positions.

recipes.name: Setback corner
build: Fillet the three edges at vertex (40, 20, 10) with radius 2 and setback distance 4 on each.

expect.check: Record body count, volume, centre of mass and the feature tree. Record setback distances.

recipes.name: FilletXpert
build: Use FilletXpert to add radius 1 to the four vertical edges.

expect.check: Record body count, volume, centre of mass and the feature tree.

recipes.name: Angle-distance chamfer
build: Chamfer the vertical edge at (40, 20) with distance_mm = 2 at 45 degrees.

expect.check: Record body count, volume, centre of mass and the feature tree.

recipes.name: Distance-distance chamfer
build: Chamfer the vertical edge at (40, 20) with 2 along X and 3 along Y.

expect.check: Record body count, volume, centre of mass and the feature tree.

recipes.name: Vertex chamfer
build: Chamfer the vertex (40, 20, 10) with 2 along each edge.

expect.check: Record body count, volume, centre of mass and the feature tree.

recipes.name: Offset face chamfer
build: Offset-face chamfer the vertical edge at (40, 20) with distance 2 on both faces.

expect.check: Record body count, volume, centre of mass and the feature tree.

recipes.name: Face-face chamfer
build: Face-face chamfer the top face and side face y = 20, symmetric distance 2.

expect.check: Record body count, volume, centre of mass and the feature tree.

recipes.name: Rib between wall and plate
build: On YZ offset to x = 20, draw a line from (y 15, z 15) to (y 5, z 5).
Add a rib of thickness_mm = 2, mid-plane, filling towards the wall and plate.

expect.check: Record body count, volume, centre of mass and the feature tree.

recipes.name: Shell removing the top face
build: Shell SeedBody inward with thickness_mm = 1, removing the top face.

expect.check: Record body count, volume, centre of mass and the feature tree.

recipes.name: Neutral plane draft
build: Draft the four side faces by 5 degrees inward going up, with the bottom face as neutral plane.

expect.check: Record body count, volume, centre of mass and the feature tree.

recipes.name: Parting line draft
build: Split the side faces with a split line at z = 5.
Add a parting-line draft of 3 degrees on that line, pull direction +Z.

expect.check: Record body count, volume, centre of mass and the feature tree. Record the parting line and draft angle.

recipes.name: Step draft
build: Split the side faces with a split line at z = 5.
Add a step draft of 3 degrees, tapered steps.

expect.check: Record body count, volume, centre of mass and the feature tree.

recipes.name: DraftXpert
build: Use DraftXpert to draft the four side faces 2 degrees inward, neutral plane the bottom face.

expect.check: Record body count, volume, centre of mass and the feature tree.

recipes.name: Combine add
build: Combine BodyA and BodyB with Add (join).

expect.check: Record body count, volume, centre of mass and the feature tree.

recipes.name: Combine subtract
build: Combine: subtract BodyB from BodyA.

expect.check: Record body count, volume, centre of mass and the feature tree.

recipes.name: Combine common
build: Combine BodyA and BodyB with Common (intersect).

expect.check: Record body count, volume, centre of mass and the feature tree.

recipes.name: Intersect with a surface
build: Make a planar surface covering z = 5 across the block.
Use Intersect with SeedBody and the surface, keeping both regions.

expect.check: Record body count, volume, centre of mass and the feature tree. Two solid regions of 4000 each; record whether the surface body is consumed or kept.

recipes.name: Split by a plane
build: Split SeedBody with a plane at split_x_mm = 20, keeping both bodies.

expect.check: Record body count, volume, centre of mass and the feature tree. Two bodies; record each volume.

recipes.name: Delete a body
build: Delete BodyB with a delete/remove body feature.

expect.check: Record body count, volume, centre of mass and the feature tree.

recipes.name: Bodies to keep
build: Cut a 2 mm slot through all from x = 19 to 21.
In the bodies-to-keep dialog keep only the body on the -X side.

expect.check: Record body count, volume, centre of mass and the feature tree.

build: Save BodyA and BodyB as two new part files.

expect.check: Record body count, volume, centre of mass and the feature tree. Each new part holds one body of 8000 mm³ and links back to the source.

recipes.name: Join parts in an assembly
build: Make an assembly with two block seed parts, the second offset by (20, 0, 0).
Create a joined part from both components.

expect.check: Record body count, volume, centre of mass and the feature tree.

recipes.name: Move body
build: Move SeedBody by dx_mm = 10 along X.

expect.check: Record body count, volume, centre of mass and the feature tree. X bounds 10 to 50.

recipes.name: Copy body
build: Copy SeedBody and translate the copy by (0, 30, 0).

expect.check: Record body count, volume, centre of mass and the feature tree.

recipes.name: Uniform scale
build: Scale SeedBody uniformly by factor 2 about the origin.

expect.check: Record body count, volume, centre of mass and the feature tree.

recipes.name: Mirror body
build: Mirror SeedBody about YZ without merging.

expect.check: Record body count, volume, centre of mass and the feature tree. Mirror X bounds -40 to 0.

Mirror a feature instead of a body.

recipes.name: Mirror part
build: Create a mirrored part of the seed part about YZ.

expect.check: Record body count, volume, centre of mass and the feature tree. X bounds -40 to 0; link to the source part retained.

recipes.name: Insert part
build: Save a block seed part, then insert it into a new part at the origin.

expect.check: Record body count, volume, centre of mass and the feature tree. Record the external reference to the source part.

recipes.name: Derived part
build: Save a block seed part in an assembly, then create a derived part from that component.

expect.check: Record body count, volume, centre of mass and the feature tree. Record the link to the source and that edits to the source propagate.

recipes.name: Create derived parts from bodies
build: Create derived parts for BodyA and BodyB.

expect.check: Record body count, volume, centre of mass and the feature tree. Two files each holding one body.

recipes.name: Move face
build: Move the face x = 40 by dx_mm = 5 in +X.

expect.check: Record body count, volume, centre of mass and the feature tree.

recipes.name: Offset face
build: Offset the top face by distance_mm = 2 outward.

expect.check: Record body count, volume, centre of mass and the feature tree.

recipes.name: Rotate face
build: Rotate the face x = 40 by 5 degrees about its bottom edge, leaning out at the top.

expect.check: Record body count, volume, centre of mass and the feature tree.

recipes.name: Delete face
build: Delete the top face without patching, leaving an open surface body.

expect.check: Record one surface body with five faces and no solid volume.

recipes.name: Delete and patch face
build: Chamfer the vertical edge at (40, 20) by 2 × 2.
Delete the chamfer face with patch (heal).

expect.check: Record body count, volume, centre of mass and the feature tree. The sharp edge returns.

recipes.name: Delete and fill face
build: Delete the top face with fill.

expect.check: Record body count, volume, centre of mass and the feature tree.

recipes.name: Replace face
build: Make a planar surface at z = 12 larger than the block.
Replace the top face with it.

expect.check: Record body count, volume, centre of mass and the feature tree. Count the surface body separately.

recipes.name: Heal edges

recipes.name: Delete hole

Delete the hole from the face.

expect.check: Record body count, volume, centre of mass and the feature tree.

recipes.name: Dome
build: Add a dome of height 5 to the top face.

expect.check: Record body count, volume, centre of mass and the feature tree. Maximum z of 15.

recipes.name: Freeform face
build: Freeform the top face: raise the centre control point by 3 mm (in Fusion, a T-spline box form edited the same way).

recipes.name: Point deform
build: Point-deform the top face at (20, 10, 10) by 3 mm in +Z with radius 10.

expect.check: Record body count, volume, centre of mass and the feature tree.

recipes.name: Indent
build: Indent BodyA with BodyB as tool, thickness 1, clearance 0.

expect.check: Record body count, volume, centre of mass and the feature tree.

recipes.name: Flex bend
build: Flex SeedBody with a bend of 90 degrees between trim planes x = 10 and x = 30.

expect.check: Record body count, volume, centre of mass and the feature tree.

recipes.name: Wrap emboss
build: Sketch the text KIT, height 5, on YZ offset to x = 15.
Wrap-emboss it onto the cylinder side face with depth 1.

expect.check: Record body count, volume, centre of mass and the feature tree.

recipes.name: Linear pattern of a boss
build: On the top face, add a boss of diameter 6 and height 5 at (5, 10).
Linear-pattern it to count = 3 along X with spacing 15.

expect.check: Record body count, volume, centre of mass and the feature tree.

recipes.name: Circular pattern of a hole
build: Add a diameter 4 through hole at (6, 0).
Circular-pattern it to count = 4 about the Z axis, equal spacing.

expect.check: Record body count, volume, centre of mass and the feature tree.

recipes.name: Curve-driven pattern
build: On the top face, add a boss of diameter 4 and height 3 at (5, 5).
Pattern it 3 times along the top edge from (0, 0, 10) to (40, 0, 10), spacing 15.

expect.check: Record body count, volume, centre of mass and the feature tree.

recipes.name: Sketch-driven pattern
build: Add a diameter 4 hole, depth 5, at (10, 10).
On the top face, sketch points at (20, 10) and (30, 10) and pattern the hole to them.

expect.check: Record body count, volume, centre of mass and the feature tree.

recipes.name: Table-driven pattern
build: Add a diameter 4 hole, depth 5, at (5, 5).
Pattern it with a coordinate table of offsets (10, 0) and (20, 5).

expect.check: Record body count, volume, centre of mass and the feature tree.

recipes.name: Fill pattern
build: Fill the top face with diameter 2 holes, depth 2, on a square layout with spacing 6 and margin 3.

expect.check: Record body count, volume, centre of mass and the feature tree. Record the instance count.

recipes.name: Variable pattern
build: Add a hole of diameter 2, depth 5, at (8, 10) with a driving diameter.
Variable-pattern it to x = 20 with diameter 3 and to x = 32 with diameter 4.

expect.check: Record body count, volume, centre of mass and the feature tree.

recipes.name: Mirror feature
build: On the top face, add a boss of diameter 6 and height 5 at (5, 10).
Mirror the boss feature about a plane at x = 20.

expect.check: Record body count, volume, centre of mass and the feature tree.

build: On XY, draw a corner rectangle (0, 0)-(40, 20) with width_mm = 40 and make a planar surface.

recipes.name: Offset surface
build: Offset SeedSurface by distance_mm = 5 in +Z.

build: Radiate the bottom edge along X at y = 0, z = 0 outward in -Y by 5, parallel to XY.

recipes.name: Ruled surface
build: Create a ruled surface normal to the top face along the edge (0, 0, 10)-(40, 0, 10), distance 5, pointing -Y.

recipes.name: Filled surface
build: Draw four lines bounding the square (0, 0, 0)-(20, 20, 0).
Fill the boundary with a contact-condition surface.

expect.check: Record surface body count, total surface area and boundary edges. Planar patch of area 400 mm².

variations: Tangent condition to a neighbouring face.

recipes.name: Mid surface
build: Create a mid surface between the top and bottom faces.

expect.check: Record surface body count, total surface area and boundary edges. Mid surface of area 800 mm² at z = 5.

recipes.name: Surface from mesh
build: Create a planar surface from the mesh facets of the top face (z = 10).

expect.check: Record surface body count, total surface area and boundary edges. New surface area 800 mm².

recipes.name: Knit surfaces into a solid
build: Make six planar surfaces bounding the box (0, 0, 0)-(40, 20, 10).
Knit them with the option to create a solid.

expect.check: Record body count, volume, centre of mass and the feature tree.

recipes.name: Extend surface
build: Extend the edge x = 40 of SeedSurface by distance_mm = 10, same surface.

expect.check: Record surface body count, total surface area and boundary edges. Area 1000 mm².

recipes.name: Trim surface
build: Sketch a line x = 30 across SeedSurface and trim, keeping the x < 30 side.

expect.check: Record surface body count, total surface area and boundary edges. Area 600 mm².

build: Make a second planar surface on XZ through y = 10 spanning x 0..40, z -5..5.
Mutual-trim both surfaces, keeping the y < 10 and z > 0 regions.

recipes.name: Untrim surface
build: Trim a diameter 10 hole at (20, 10) from SeedSurface.
Untrim the internal hole edge.

expect.check: Record surface body count, total surface area and boundary edges. Area back to 800 mm².

recipes.name: Surface flatten
build: Surface-revolve a line from (10, 0) to (10, 10) on XZ by 180 degrees about Z.
Flatten it onto XY.

expect.check: Record surface body count, total surface area and boundary edges. Flattened area 100*pi mm².

recipes.name: Parting surface
build: Add a parting line on the side faces at z = 5 with pull direction +Z.
Create a parting surface 5 mm wide, perpendicular to the pull.

expect.check: Record surface body count, total surface area and boundary edges. Record the parting surface width and direction.

recipes.name: Thicken a surface
build: Thicken SeedSurface by thickness_mm = 2 to the +Z side.

expect.check: Record body count, volume, centre of mass and the feature tree. Solid volume 1600 mm³.

recipes.name: Thickened cut
build: Make a planar surface at z = 8 covering the block.
Thickened-cut with thickness 2 to the -Z side.

expect.check: Record body count, volume, centre of mass and the feature tree. Two solid bodies remain, 6400 mm³ together.

recipes.name: Cut with surface
build: Make a planar surface at z = 6 covering the block.
Cut SeedBody with the surface, keeping the region below.

expect.check: Record body count, volume, centre of mass and the feature tree.

recipes.name: Helix
build: On the top face sketch a circle of diameter 20.
Create a constant-pitch helix: pitch 2, height 10, start angle 0, clockwise.

recipes.name: Spiral
build: On XY sketch a circle of diameter 10.
Create a spiral of pitch 5 with 3 revolutions.

recipes.name: Projected curve
build: On XZ draw a line from (-5, 2) to (5, 8) in (x, z).

expect.check: Every sampled point lies at radius 10.

recipes.name: Composite curve
build: Make a composite curve from top edges (0, 0)-(40, 0), (40, 0)-(40, 20) and (40, 20)-(0, 20) at z = 10.

build: Create a curve through (0, 0, 0), (10, 5, 5) and (20, 0, 10).

build: Create a curve through the vertices (0, 0, 10) and (40, 20, 10).

expect.check: Record a straight curve of length sqrt(2000).

recipes.name: Split line
build: On the top face sketch a line x = 20 and split the top face with it.

build: Set thickness thickness_mm = 1, bend radius 1, K-factor 0.5.

recipes.name: Tab
build: On the top face, sketch a 10 × 10 rectangle from (40, 5) to (50, 15) touching the edge x = 40, and add a tab.

expect.check: Record body count, volume, centre of mass and the feature tree. Also record thickness, bend radius, K-factor and every bend.

build: Shell SeedBody by 1, removing the top face.

expect.check: Record body count, volume, centre of mass and the feature tree. Also record thickness, bend radius, K-factor and every bend.

recipes.name: Edge flange

expect.check: Record body count, volume, centre of mass and the feature tree. Also record thickness, bend radius, K-factor and every bend.

recipes.name: Miter flange
build: Sketch an L profile 10 × 5 on the end face x = 0 and add a miter flange along the edges y = 20 and x = 40.

expect.check: Record body count, volume, centre of mass and the feature tree. Also record thickness, bend radius, K-factor and every bend.

recipes.name: Swept flange
